_comment: Deterministic harness settings. The plugin shipped none, so self.stock_data stayed empty and every panel rendered blank: the crash and overflow checks ran against an empty frame and nothing about the ticker layout -- fonts, colours, the inline chart, symbol widths -- was ever exercised (#395). The cached quotes below cover a gain (AAPL, MSFT), a loss (NVDA) and a crypto entry (BTC), and the symbol lists are pinned to exactly those so no live fetch is attempted. display_mode is 'switch' because frame 0 of a scroll is legitimately blank -- the ticker starts off-panel -- so a single display() call in scroll mode draws nothing. The scroll variant is kept alongside it so the scroll path still has to survive the harness.
